build_input_adapter: build an InputAdapter that chains steps to transform PyTorch model inputs into ONNX-compatible format
build_output_adapter: build an OutputAdapter that chains steps to transform PyTorch model outputs into ONNX-compatible format
test_flatten_input_step: test FlattenInputWithTreeSpecValidationInputStep to flatten nested collections and validate tree spec consistency
refactor_complex_input_step: refactor ConvertComplexToRealRepresentationInputStep to convert complex dtype tensors to real representation for ONNX
summarize_prepend_params_step: summarize PrependParamsBuffersConstantAotAutogradInputStep to prepend model parameters, buffers, and constants to user inputs
